about:
I'm a second-year Computing Technologies student at Ulster University in Belfast.

Most of what I know I've learned by building real things for real people. I build and maintain the website for a small internet radio station in Newry, made for older listeners who aren't confident with technology. I also built a Flask app the presenter uses on air to take song requests.

I've worked part-time alongside my studies since 2021, in warehouses, kitchens and on a production line. That work taught me to stay calm when things break and to finish the job properly.
